hook: If you cried in space, your tears would not fall.
title: Your Tears Won't Fall In Space
description:
In microgravity there is nothing to pull tears down your face. They cling to the eye and gather into a wobbling liquid ball. Astronaut Chris Hadfield showed this on the International Space Station.

#Shorts #Space #ISS
